body:
Invoked actual modern shell updater dispatch and controlled native replies, and added original portable dispatch/preparation support in `270612ffee6c4446fc41755fe09794479c2c6236`.

Six native PreviewShellModernUpdaterInterface.update calls reach an owned primitive-send witness and yield complete/minimal update requests with generated IDs0…5. Two immediate native TransportReply.send() Unit acknowledgements produce Future.hasFinishedSuccessfully=true on return. Two retained native24-byte reply copies produce false initially, then true on the same returned Future after original source shell destruction and deferred Unit acknowledgement. Two no-reply controls read false; this predicate alone does not establish pending/error/terminal state or eventual completion. Six shell/output-plist destroy calls, two reply-copy destroys and six Future reference releases return; no unique final native/OS/provider release inferred. Unit success is callback acknowledgement, not provider output or target update application.

Owned transport is ABI-shaped storage with UInt64 metadata/token and supplied primitive witness, not a registered native Swift daemon conformance or actual daemon connection. Modern layout52/56/8, fields0/40 guarded; selected code does not read capability tail or inherited invalidation witness. No interface constructor/general conformance claim. Actual method invocation and controlled callbacks are native runtime evidence.3060 source instruction bytes verified, four framework runtime UUIDs match source images. REA6.2.0 expected command/package/catalog aligned; closed/provider null.

Original ShellServiceTransport/dispatch_shell_update allocates one shared-process ID, sends one typed request and preserves backend pending identity. Backend owns callbacks/scheduling/resources. inspect-service-message --prepare-update wraps a standalone shell value through a value-only backend; it sends nothing.394 full Rust tests pass;12 native CLI and12 actual WASI canonical/preparation controls pass;6 WASM-prepared requests pass actual native ServiceMessage decoding/encoding; fresh disposable replay passes. WASM SHA25625406a48b221957e3f100354a4ca469a10dfb2a6b4445d5725fef31901d020a2. Each new CLI/WASI process starts its own ID sequence. Existing nested sourceFilePaths/linkerFlags Set wire-order distinction preserved; ordered arrays unchanged. Compile-only harness/linker/shadowing failures and initial overly strict Set comparison retained and corrected. Native8s/compiler30s/WASI10s deadlines, replay180s.

Evidence: https://github.com/aspauldingcode/xcpreviewer-rs/tree/development/research/evidence/modern-shell-dispatch-2026-10-27 (seal `34a1401e8d3133cb39982a313077ea3572b226c00bfc25ac41ed227ee2e2d3fb`). Only original helpers/owned fixtures/sanitized findings published; raw Apple instructions/symbol dumps local ignored. User staging and remote changes preserved, development/master synchronized. Both earlier GitHub outboxes have now synchronized.

Actual DaemonConnection delivery, scene/workspace routing, error/cancellation/repeated-reply behavior, update application, Canvas rendering/interaction and final resource settlement remain open; both milestones incomplete. Next recover/correlate DaemonConnection<DaemonClientRole> primitive-send with the qualified native resource carrier and this modern request boundary.
next_attempt_policy: REST read-before-post; reuse unique commit comment; preserve partial events; backoff30minutes on write limit
